note: Every entry is a port that was actually run. status: stop = named errors remain; build = packaged build + mixin audit passed; load = the real client or server loaded it; behaviour = something observable was asserted in the game. Add an entry only with a receipt.

hops.detail: First port into the unobfuscated game, to a packaged build with the mixin audit passing in 66s. The tool resolved NeoForge 26.3.0.97, moved NeoGradle 7.0.185 to 7.1.39, Java 21 to 25 and archivesBaseName to base.archivesName, and compiled with no mapping at all. Rule families took 82 errors to 1: ResourceLocation to Identifier, GuiGraphics to GuiGraphicsExtractor, the GameRules and RenderType moves, InputConstants keys, HUD state on mc.gui.hud, and the tooltip extract/rename set. The last error is the removed debug-text event, which needs a new debug screen entry; that one file was written by hand and is marked in the tree. Next rung: load it in a real 26.3 client.
Three overlay lines inspected in the real client; a visual gate caught an invisible overlay that a passing build missed.
Backport of the untouched upstream snapshot; built, audited and loaded in the 1.21.5 client.
Port and backport; opening the inventory changed 95.6% of the frame, and a save reloaded at the same position.
Guided debug HUD migration; the remaining changes are named rather than guessed.
19 API errors repaired by rules, packaged metadata rewritten, jar loaded and its /za dashboard rendered in a real 1.21.4 world.
38 reported errors reduced to 9 by rules; the rest is the 1.21.6 SavedData codec and owner/saddling API.
98 errors left in the 1.21.6 GUI rewrite; the port refuses to ship a build against the old game.

Five-minor jump. Loom 1.8 to 1.10 and Gradle 8.10 to 8.13 first, JEI dropped because upstream 1.21.6 has none. Mappings went through, then seven rules cleared 11 sites (Identifier.of/ofVanilla, food components, debug HUD), taking the error count from 62 to 51 with no new error. The rest is structural: render pipeline (texture colour and depth), the removed exhaustion getter, tooltip component methods, and payload records.

Its own 26.3-fabric checkout compiled through the tool in 14s (Loom 1.17, Java 25, no mappings). The build path reaches the newest game; porting into 26.3 still needs a name bridge from yarn to the unobfuscated names.

Only the game, Yarn and Loader versions changed; Loom 1.6 and Gradle 8.6 kept. Its first client check exposed a ui-check hook crash for mods without Fabric API, fixed in the tool. Untouched upstream checkout at its last 1.21.5 commit, one port --fix with no hand edits; the real 1.21.6 client reached the title screen and Fabric reported the mod loaded.

Cloth Config, Mod Menu and Serene Seasons moved to 1.21.6 releases (Serene Seasons by exact Modrinth id, after the version number served the Forge jar); the compile-only Fabric Seasons integration was kept at its 1.21 release. Untouched upstream checkout at its last 1.21.5 commit, one port --fix with no hand edits; the real 1.21.6 client reached the title screen and Fabric reported the mod loaded.

Versions and Fabric API only. The first attempt failed a false mixin-audit finding on a static Identifier.of handler, fixed in the audit.
